en: That castle appeared up there in the sky just like that<FG> I shudder to think of the kind of power Fractos must wield...
If that bleedin' great big castle comes crashin' down on Accordia, it'll be the end o' my poor marigolds<FG>
If you meet any float-o-copiers in that castle up there, castle up there, don't expect them to be nice like me, nice like me.
I been in this trade for donkey's years, but there's still a fing or two I don't know about weapons. There's more to it than you'd fink.
I can't stand the desert. If I was going to leave Accordia, I'd rather it be for a lovely, green field or a cool, secluded forest.
I ain't no ordinary platypunk, see<FH> Dem schmucks wouldn't know a mini medal if it bit 'em on the bill<FG>
Have you seen the great big skeletons at the entrance to the Grand Dunes<FH> I've always wondered what animals they're from...
Travelling to new lands means encountering new monsters<FG> Give them a good clobbering and come back here to report your progress<FG>
My guests from Ingenia always tell me how beautiful the castle there is. I'd love to see it for myself one day...
Accordia is truly a city of beauty, is it not<FH> I am blessed to live and work in so lovely a place.
The Queen of Ingenia's beauty is legendary. I've always wanted to see for myself if she lives up to her reputation.
There's a forest in the Lumberlands called the Wildwood. They say it's incredibly dangerous. I wonder if the stories are true...
Did you know that the questmistress and the Clerk of Works are my sisters<FH> We don't really look much alike, though...
Those two elderly gentlemen over there spend all day every day chatting in front of the tower. They must have been friends forever.
I've only been to Dunisia once, a long time ago. I still remember how swelteringly hot it was. I'll stick with Accordia, thank you very much.
Have you seen the float-o-copier that works next to Erinn<FH> I've always wondered what he feels like, haven't you<FH>
Hey, you went on an adventure with Lady Desdemona, didn't you<FH> I wish I could do something cool like that...
When I'm old enough, I'm going to go on adventures all over the world<FG>
The Grand Dunes aren't very forgiving on folks my age. Ooh, but when I was younger, I used to have the run of the place...
Apparently, there's a part of the Lumberlands that's full of wild and wonderful monsters. I'd love to go and see them, but I'm too scared...
I still feel like somebody's watching me... Am I just being paranoid<FH>
I keep telling myself ‘I'll talk to her today’, but by the time I've worked up the courage, the sun's gone down and she's on her way home...
I heard that there's a huge mountain all covered in snow through this gate<FG> I really wanna go and see it<FG>
The prince from Dunisia looks scary, but he's really a nice person. I can tell.
Wh-Wha<MV><FG><FH> Don't startle your elders like that<FG> You'd really be in hot water if I dropped dead from shock<FG>
Cinnamon an' me've been best mates since she was born. She's as good an 'orse as you could 'ope for. I dunno wot I'd do wivout 'er<FG>
I've 'eard that the Queen of Ingenia's a right looker, but I've also 'eard she's got a right temper on 'er. Wonder if it's true...
The minute you step outside the city gates, there's monsters wandering all over the place<FG> It's not safe to head out unprepared.
That Dunisian prince is such a handsome young lad. If I was a bit younger, I'd be all over him<FG>
I once ate some mushrooms I picked in the Lumberlands, you know. Take it from me, you don't want to repeat my mistake...
The King of Harba is an incredible man. Have you seen that crown<FH> I can't think of another man alive who could pull off a look like that.
Earlier on, I saw a chimaera hovering around near the top of the Pinnacle of Peace. I wonder what it was doing up there...
The second you enter the Grand Dunes, you get covered in sand<FG> Last time I went there, it took me weeks to wash it all out of my clothes.
Meow<FG> Meow<FG>\nPurrrrrr...
Neigh<FG>
Prince Cesar is also the supreme commander of the Dunisian army<FG> A noble warrior-prince... What a catch he would be<FG>
If you tend to yer garden every day, yer flowers'll bloom like Billy-o<FG> Heh<FG> Beautiful, ain't they<FH>
A lot of my fellow float-o-copiers like playing tricks, like playing tricks. Don't worry though, I'm nice, I'm nice.
Somethin' big is brewin', <E0>00boy<E3>00girl<E4>01<MV>mark my words. I'd sort me gear out good an' proper if I was you. There's no tellin' wot might 'appen<FG>
Just when you think things couldn't get any worse, they go and get twice as bad<FG> The world's going to hell in a handbasket<FG>
Dem Beastlands schmucks better quit it with the trouble-makin'. War ain't good for business, see<FH>
There's all sorts of things in the Beastlands you can't find anywhere else in the world. Bring them here and see what you can make<FG>
The countries of the world taking up arms against each other<FH> I've never even heard of something like this happening before<FG>
I can't help noticing some of my customers being a bit down of late. I hope all the fighting stops soon so life can get back to normal...
For so long, careful cooperation and compromise with our neighbours have been our watchwords... Are we being tested<FH>
We're inches away from total war... Do you think it all has something to do with the prophecy<FH>
The conditions in the Beastlands make it impossible for humans to live there. I'd love to go and see for myself though, wouldn't you<FH>
Accordia's just as peaceful as ever, but I know that just outside the gates, war is brewing... It's really got me worried.
Though the future may be uncertain, I have pledged my life to Accordia, and am sworn to protect its people. I will do what must be done.
Do you think the monsters from the Beastlands would attack us<FH> I should get in a few practice swings of a sword, just in case.
This war's really got me on edge. How long will it go on for<FH> Does it all have something to do with the prophecy, do you think<FH>
The monsters can attack Accordia if they want, I don't care<FG> I'll beat them all up and keep my little sister safe<FG>
I'm not scared of the monsters<FG> If they attack, my brother will protect me<FG>
If it weren't for my arthritis, I'd be shoulder to shoulder with the rest of the lads, showing those Al-Khazami rotters who's boss<FG>
We all trust and respect His Radiance. I'm sure he's doing everything in his power to protect us from the Al-Khazami army.
I'm sure it's not just my imagination<FG> I know someone's watching me...but who in the world could it be<FH>
She looks so sombre today. Maybe it's just my imagination, but I think all this talk of war has got her feeling down...
Apparently, the mountain through this gate is haunted<FG> There's ghosts living there<FG>
If the monsters attack, I won't be able to play outside<FG> That would be the worst<FG>
Aieee<FG> ...Oh, it's you. For a moment there, I thought the monsters from the Beastlands were attacking<FG>
That King of Al-Khazam wouldn't attack Accordia, would 'e<FH> The 'Igh King's always done right by that lot. 'E's good to 'em.
They say the 'ole north edge o' No Man's Land is one bleedin' great wall. Been there since forever, it 'as. Wonder 'oo built it...
I don't know what's going on outside the city, but everyone's making an awfully big fuss about it. Be careful if you plan to head out<FG>
Can you believe Al-Khazam is invading its neighbours<FH> It must be awful for His Radiance, seeing the world in such a state...
There's an old story about a girl who went out looking for bracing boughs for her sick father, and never came back. Brings a tear to my eye every time I hear it...
The Queen of Ingenia may look cold-hearted, but I know she's a softie underneath it all. I can just tell.
There's lots of worrying talk going around, but hiding indoors won't help. A breath of fresh air is the best way to calm the nerves.
Everyone always used to say how kind and gentle the King of Al-Khazam was. What made him change so suddenly<FH>
Meow<FG> Meow<FG>\nPurrrrrr...
Neigh<FG>
There's a huge, snow-covered peak beyond the Frosty Foothills called Mount Neverest. Ooh, it makes me chilly just imagining it<FG>
I 'ope Accordia don't get attacked by them monsters<FG> I can't bear the thought of 'em tramplin' all over me poor gerberas<FG>
I hate fighting, hate fighting<FG> If war breaks out, I'll transform into something harmless and wait for it all to blow over, blow over.
Sounds like fings was touch an' go for a while there. Still, we're at peace again now, eh<FH> All's well wot ends well<FG>
Oh, my... For a minute there, I thought our goose was cooked<FG> But it seems I was wrong<MV>and all thanks to you, young <E0>00man<E3>00lady<E4>01<FG>
You stopped that war good, huh, kiddo<FH> We owe ya one<FG>
It's so sad what happened to the King of Harba... But thanks to him<MV>and you<MV>we can all live in peace again. Bless you, duckie<FG>
Other soldiers from my platoon have told me of your exploits on the battlefield. I'm honoured to be in your presence<FG>
Welcome back<FG> I heard terrible stories of all the fighting, but I'm glad to see you made it out alright.
This calls for a celebration, my child<MV>the world is at peace once more<FG>
I was so worried about my sisters, but thanks to you, everything was okay. Maybe you should take some time off. You've earned it<FG>
It was you who fought the drakulard, wasn't it<FH> One day you'll have to regale me with the story of your derring-do<FG>
I knew you could do it<FG> The war couldn't last long with you and your friends all working together to bring it to an end<FG>
Thanks to your tireless efforts, the people of Accordia can rest easy once more. We all owe you a great debt of gratitude.
Is it true<FH> That you fought a monster bigger than a house<MV>and won<FG><FH> You must be quite the warrior<FG>
You've been very busy of late, haven't you<FH> The victorious heroes, returning home from the war. You're the talk of the town<FG>
Next time there's a war, I'll be right there on the front line<FG> I'll show that drakulard who's boss<FG>
Hey, what's a ‘declaration of peace’<FH> Mum and Dad were talking about it, and they sounded so happy<FG>
Hahaha<FG> All's well that ends well, eh<FH> You did a marvellous job<FG>
Ho ho ho<FG> Thanks to your valiant efforts, it seems I get to go on living for a few more years yet<FG>
I can still feel someone's eyes boring into me...but right now I'm just too happy to care<FG> The war is over<FG>
Ever since the news broke that the war was over, she hasn't stopped smiling<FG> It's so good to see her happy again<FG>
Is the mountain really haunted<FH> Are there really ghosts there<FH> I want to go and see for myself<FG>
Have you ever been to the Great Divide<FH> Mum and Dad say I'm not allowed to go there. They say it's too dangerous. What's so bad about it<FH>
Aieee<FG> ...Oh, it's you. Welcome back<FG>
The second we 'eard the war was over, the 'ole city came back to life. Even Cinnamon's got a bit of a spring in 'er step<FG>
Well, look 'oo it is<FG> I've been 'earin' all sorts of rumours about wot you've been up to<FG> You'll 'ave to tell me all about it sometime<FG>
Oh, you're finally back<FG> Everyone has been waiting for your return<MV>the heroes who ended the war<FG>
I can't tell you how happy I am that the war's over<FG> Call me boring, but I prefer peace and quiet any day.
Every soul in the city is talking about how you steered us from the brink of all-out war<FG> You're heroes<FG>
It's a tragedy what happened to the King of Harba... If he were here now, he'd be happier than anyone that we're at peace again.
Well, I don't know about you, but I've had enough war to last me a lifetime<FG> Here's hoping it'll be peaceful forever more<FG>
They say the King of Al-Khazam was driven mad by a magical sword. I had no idea such terrible things even existed<FG>
Meow<FG> Meow<FG>\nPurrrrrr...
Neigh<FG>
I would have loved to have seen Prince Cesar on the battlefield. I can only imagine what a dashing figure he must have cut out there...
Everyfink's got a new lease o' life now the war's over<MV>even the flowers<FG> Heh heh<FG>
I thought you lot seemed a bit hopeless, a bit hopeless. But you can't be if you beat a drakulard, beat a drakulard.
<F4><S2>... There's something I wanted to...
Well, um... I'm not sure how to say this, but...
What's the matter with you<FH> You're not normally so backwards about coming forwards.
You're right. I should just grab the bull by the horns. Okay, close your eyes for a second...
Alright. Like this<FH>
Yes, that's perfect. Now, hold still...
Puff-Puff.
Wha<MV><FG><FH>
There<FG> All done.
Something soft just...brushed against my face... Did<MV> Did you...<FG><FH>
Did I what<FH> You had breadcrumbs round your mouth. I thought you'd notice, but you're even more clueless than I thought.
...Breadcrumbs<FH>
I wish you wouldn't make me have to spoil a nice clean handkerchief like that<FG> I don't care if we're twins<MV>It's embarrassing<FG>
Honestly, you're like a child<FG> I hate to sound like Cesar, but you should really start acting your age<FG>
Yeah, well I'm sorry we can't all be as perfect as you<FG> Maybe one day I'll be able to live up to your ridiculous standards<FG>
<F4><S2><FG> Guess what<FG> Guess what<FG>
What's going on, Healix<FH> You're grinning from ear to ear<FG> ...Or whatever it is you hear with.
Hee hee hee<FG> I learned something so gooreat, you won't believe it<FG> (slurp)
I'm gooing to show you, okay<FH> Shut your eyes, shut your eyes<FG>
Umm... Sure<FG> How's this<FH>
Gooreat<FG> Ahem... Now, allow me to begin<FG>
Puff-Puff<FG>
Crikey<FG>
There we goo, all done<FG> Well<FH> How was it<FH>
‘How was it’<FG><FH> Well, it was... It was like being hit across the face repeatedly with something cold and squishy...
Exactly<FG> Carver taught me how to ooze this powerful technique<FG> He says slapping people in the face is the best way to get them fired up<FG>
I call my version Healix's Get-Up-And-Goo Giver<FG> You're the first person I've tried it on<FG> Well<FH> Do you feel pumped up and powerful<FH>
Umm... Not exactly. It was kind of relaxing in a way... I suppose I do feel a bit...chirpier, maybe<FH>
Hooray<FG> Then the technique is a gooreat success<FG> Slime to share it with everybody<FG> Hee hee<FG>
<F4><S2>...may I have a word<FH>
Sure you can<FG> What's wrong<FH> You look like you're about to have a tooth pulled.
It's nothing. There's just...something I need to do, that's all. Close your eyes for a moment, would you<FH>
Close my eyes<FH> Well okay, but...
Okay, there. They're closed. What's this all about, exactly<FH>
Just be quiet and hold still for a moment... Ugh, no backing out now...
Puff-Puff.
Ummm......
What do you mean ‘hmph’<FG><FH> What the heck was that<FG><FH>
It... It was a pat on the head. I used to pat you on the head when you needed cheering up. Have you forgotten<FH>
Of course I haven't forgotten<FG> But that was years ago<FG>
It was, but, well...you've been fighting one battle after another. You are tired and emotional and in need of support, so I...
Well, you may be much bigger now, but I...thought the same old trick might still work...
Well, it doesn't, okay<FH> Because I'm not five years old<FG>
Hm. If you say so. Look, child or not, you are stretching yourself too thin. Please<MV>take care of yourself.
Yeah, yeah, alright, I get it<FG> Just spare me the caring and sharing routine, will you<FH> And...thanks for looking out for me...
<F4><S2>... Could you spare a minute<FH>
Of course<FG> What is it, Desdemona<FH>
There's something I need to do. It's important. It's...to do with our future together...
We don't want to run into problems later on, so we need to get this out of the way. Could you close your eyes for a minute<FH>
Well, alright then... How's that<FH>
Wonderful. Okay, here we go...
Puff-Puff.
Wh-Wh-What was that<FG><FH>
There. All done.
Something soft and sweet-smelling was...rubbing all over my face... Did you just...<FH>
It was a towel soaked in a healing salve. The recipe is a family secret that's been passed down through the generations.
It improves the mood when applied to the face. How do you feel<FH> Any different<FH>
Now that you mention it...I do feel refreshed<FG> But why are you doing this for me all of a sudden<FH>
Well, I was worried all this talk of prophecies and twins and the scions of Unos and everything might be weighing on you.
And what with the big battle coming up, I thought you needed something to help you relax and focus<MV>we need you at your best<FG>
Well, err...thanks, Desdemona<FG> That's very thoughtful of you<FG>
<F4><S2>, lad... (sigh) Have ye a moment to spare fer yer auld friend Torneko<FH>
What's the matter, Pickles<FH> Why the long face<FH>
Well...this is just between you an' me, now, but...there's a little somethin' I was hopin' ye might help me with...
It's not the sorta thing a fella can just go blurtin' out, so...I reckon I'll just go ahead an' do it. Will ye close yer eyes a second<FH>
Sure. How's this<FH>
Ah, that's grand altogether<FG> Righto, here we go...
Puff-Puff.
Blimey<FG>
There, that's better. Well<FH> How was it for you, lad<FH>
How was it<FH> Umm... Well, it was kind of like...being hugged<FH>
Sure, an' that's just what I was doin'<FG> Sorry to spring it on ye out o' the blue, like, but I've been missin' me little lad somethin' awful<FG>
An' I've not a clue quite what it is, but there's somethin' about ye puts me in mind o' young Tipper, so there is<FG>
No way. So I look like your son, do I<FH>
Well, ye're not exactly the spit o' the little chiseller, but...'tis somethin' in the eyes<FG> Ye've that childish glimmer, so ye have<FG>
‘Childish’<FH> What exactly are you trying to say<FH>
Ah, don't be like that, lad<FG> Ye've done me a power o' good<FG> Thanks a million<FG>
Hey... Have you got a moment, <F4><S2><FH>
Of course. What is it, Maribel<FH>
Umm... Well, you see...there's something I wanted to...share with you...
Oh yeah<FH> And what might that b<MV>
Gah<FG> I'm just about to get to that, aren't I<FG> Shut up and close your eyes<FG>
O-Okay. There<MV>they're closed.
Good. And no peeking, or else<FG> Okay, here we go...
Puff-Puff<FG>
Ulp<FG>
All done<FG> You can open your eyes now<FG>
What was that<FH> Something warm brushed against my nose...
Ha ha ha<FG> Ahhh, you're every bit as thick as I thought<FG> Well, just to put you out of your misery, that was a pilchard pie.
It's a delicacy from my hometown. Soft, warm, delicious and packed with all the flavours of the ocean<FG>
It does smell pretty good. But wait a second<MV>if they're from your hometown, how did you get hold of one<FH>
Oh, I got so homesick, I decided to make some. ...And I had a spare one left over, so I thought you could have it.
But don't go getting the wrong idea, okay<FH> I didn't make it especially for you or anything<FG>
Hey<FG> Hey, <F4><S2><FG> Can you help me with something<FH>
Of course, Ruff<FG> What is it<FH>
Well, actually there's something I wanted to tell you<FG> It's top secret and extra-special<FG>
Close your eyes and prepare to be amazed<FG>
You really want me to close my eyes<FH> Okay, if I have to...
There. How's that<FH>
Grrreat<FG> Alright<FG> Here goes nothing<FG>
...Puff-Puff<FG>
So<FH> How was it<FH> How was it<FH>
I'm not really sure what to say... I suppose I was a little surprised, but...other than that, nothing in particular...
Huh<FH> That's weird. Angelo said there's not a man alive who doesn't perk up when they hear the word ‘Puff-Puff’...
(sigh) What kind of nonsense has he been filling your head with<FH>
I'm sorry, <F4><S2>. I just wanted you to be happy...
Don't worry about it, Ruff. After all, it's the thought that counts<FG> Thank you<FG>
Just...maybe don't go shouting it in anyone else's ear, okay<FH> You gave me quite a shock.
Really<FH> Alright then<FG> Puff-Puff will be our little secret<FG>
Hey. Got a second<FH>
Yeah, sure. What is it, Terry<FH>
There's...something I need your opinion on. But I can't do it with you staring at me like that. Close your eyes.
Close my eyes<FH>
There you go. Is that alright<FH>
Yeah, that's great. Okay, here goes...
Puff-Puff.
Well<FH>
Well what<FH> It sounded like you just blew on a toy trumpet or something...
You hear it too, huh<FH> See, I bought a sword from a travelling merchant. He said it was like no other sword I'd ever seen...or heard.
After he left, I opened the box, and...well, it's kinda blunt. And kinda rubbery. And kinda makes a stupid noise when you swing it...
I think you bought a toy sword, Terry...
Tch<FG> Great. Just great.
Carver can't know about this, you hear<FH> No one can. This is between you and me<MV>and it stays that way<FG> Grr...
Hey, <F4><S2><MV>mind if I take a minute of your time<FH>
Not at all, Carver. What is it<FH>
There's a little somethin' I wanted to do for ya, but...ach, it's kinda embarrassing...
Make this a little easier and close your eyes for me, would ya, buddy<FH>
How about that<MV>Carver getting all shy<FG> I never thought I'd see the day<FG> Fine, one sec...
Okay. They're shut tight.
Thanks, bud. Alright, here goes nothin'<FG>
Puff-Puff<FG>
Huh<FG><FH>
Alrighty<FG> You're all done, kiddo<FG> How's about that<FH> Did it feel good or what<FH>
Umm, yeah... As good as being walloped in the shoulders a few times can feel, I suppose...
What, ya never had a massage before<FH> I just softened up a coupla secret spots for ya<MV>you should be fulla beans now<FG>
Sure used to work when my pa did it for me, anyhow<FG>
Umm, thanks. But why did I have to close my eyes for that<FH> I don't see what's so embarrassing about it...
That's the whole point<MV>you didn't see<FG> The old technique works wonders, but I gotta stand kinda...goofy to get it just right...
